subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should a cold Mattermost thread turn await the branch's bounded, fail-open server-history recovery before dispatch, accepting that latency to preserve context after restart or session rotation?
rationale: Tests and live proof establish correctness, but repository evidence cannot choose the channel's acceptable first-turn latency and availability tradeoff on behalf of the Mattermost owner.

options.title: Accept bounded recovery latency
options.body: Keep the awaited fail-open recovery so the first post-restart or post-reset reply receives prior thread context, then rebase and validate the exact head.

options.title: Move recovery off the critical path
options.body: Redesign the first cold turn to dispatch without waiting, accepting that its reply may lack recovered context while later turns benefit from the completed fetch.

options.title: Pause this recovery behavior
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and close or narrow this PR if the channel should never add a server request to inbound dispatch.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded recovery latency
recommendation.body: Keep the awaited fail-open recovery so the first post-restart or post-reset reply receives prior thread context, then rebase and validate the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the named Mattermost area owner and merged the closest prior thread-context behavior.
